verses.text: My son, if you accept my words and hide my commandments within you,

segments.text: My son, if you accept my words and hide my commandments within you,

verses.text: if you incline your ear to wisdom and direct your heart to understanding,

segments.text: if you incline your ear to wisdom and direct your heart to understanding,

verses.text: if you truly call out to insight and lift your voice to understanding,

segments.text: if you truly call out to insight and lift your voice to understanding,

verses.text: if you seek it like silver and search it out like hidden treasure,

segments.text: if you seek it like silver and search it out like hidden treasure,

verses.text: then you will discern the fear of the LORD and discover the knowledge of God.

segments.text: then you will discern the fear of the LORD and discover the knowledge of God.

verses.text: For the LORD gives wisdom; from His mouth come knowledge and understanding.

segments.text: For the LORD gives wisdom; from His mouth come knowledge and understanding.

verses.text: He stores up sound wisdom for the upright; He is a shield to those who walk with integrity,

segments.text: He stores up sound wisdom for the upright; He is a shield to those who walk with integrity,

verses.text: to guard the paths of justice and protect the way of His saints.

segments.text: to guard the paths of justice and protect the way of His saints.

verses.text: Then you will discern righteousness and justice and equity—every good path.

segments.text: Then you will discern righteousness and justice and equity—every good path.

verses.text: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will delight your soul.

segments.text: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will delight your soul.

verses.text: Discretion will watch over you, and understanding will guard you,

segments.text: Discretion will watch over you, and understanding will guard you,

verses.text: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the man who speaks perversity,

segments.text: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the man who speaks perversity,

verses.text: from those who leave the straight paths to walk in the ways of darkness,

segments.text: from those who leave the straight paths to walk in the ways of darkness,

verses.text: from those who enjoy doing evil and rejoice in the twistedness of evil,

segments.text: from those who enjoy doing evil and rejoice in the twistedness of evil,

verses.text: whose paths are crooked and whose ways are devious.

segments.text: whose paths are crooked and whose ways are devious.

verses.text: It will rescue you from the forbidden woman, from the stranger with seductive words

segments.text: It will rescue you from the forbidden woman, from the stranger with seductive words

verses.text: who abandons the partner of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.

segments.text: who abandons the partner of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.

verses.text: For her house sinks down to death, and her tracks to the departed spirits.

verses.text: None who go to her return or negotiate the paths of life.

verses.text: So you will follow in the ways of the good, and keep to the paths of the righteous.

segments.text: So you will follow in the ways of the good, and keep to the paths of the righteous.

verses.text: For the upright will inhabit the land, and the blameless will remain in it;

segments.text: For the upright will inhabit the land, and the blameless will remain in it;

verses.text: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful will be uprooted.
